description: This file defines the Banner controller class for the OpenCart admin panel, handling CRUD operations, listing, enabling/disabling, and rendering views for banner management.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for managing banners in the admin panel, including listing, editing, enabling, disabling, and deleting banners.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main banner management page with list and controls.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the list of banners with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a banner.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing banner, with validation.
